root_cause_hypothesis:
SCORED OUTCOME: build 1 / bp_clean 0 / golden_match 1. One scaffold call produced all six objects; xppc reported 0 errors / 0 warnings on both the incremental and the full build; xppbp reported 0 ERRORS (the case bar) and 10 warnings scoped to this case's objects (9 on the tmp table + 1 menu-item-not-covered-by-privilege; the model-wide run's other 6 warnings are all on the pre-existing fixture table ConDemoNoteHeader).

WHAT THE CASE TESTS - all satisfied by the generated design, unedited: the design is the XML TYPE i:type="AxReportPrecisionDesign" (not a property); the RDL detail cells are =Fields!<Column>.Value; the page header carries =Parameters!AX_CompanyName.Value; the group-header and grand-total cells are =Sum(Fields!CreditMax.Value) in the DESIGN while processReport() inserts detail rows only (no X++ aggregation, so no double count); the six platform parameters appear only where the framework itself declares them (AxReportParameter metadata + the RDL QueryParameters) and no X++ declares or passes one; there is no RDL <Code> block. designStyle="GroupedWithTotals" groups on the first non-numeric field and sums every field whose dataType is System.Double/Int32/Int64 - passing structured fields[] with explicit edt AND dataType is what steers that; fieldsHint alone cannot express it.

MULTI-LINE ATTRIBUTE BLOCKS SURVIVED THE WRITE. The DP declaration on disk still carries the class attribute as a three-line block - [ / SRSReportParameterAttribute(classStr(ConDemoCreditLimitReportContract)) / ] - and the getter still carries [SRSReportDataSetAttribute(tableStr(ConDemoCreditLimitReportTmp))]. Both survived a subsequent d365fo_file(modify, replace-code) on a different method of the same class. The just-fixed write path holds.

DEFECT 1 (TOOL_DEFECT, generator, design-level - the subject of this very case). With caption="@SYS313987" the scaffold labels the metadata correctly (tmp table Label, menu item Label, design Caption all get the label id) but writes the RDL title textbox as a LITERAL: Textbox Name="ReportTitle" with Value @SYS313987. Shipped RDL references a label as =Labels!@SYS313987 (verified: ApplicationSuite/Foundation AxReport files contain =Labels!@SYS... and =Labels!@Module:Id forms). A bare @Id in a Value is not label-transformed at deploy, so the rendered header prints the raw label id to the user. The RDL column-header cells have the same shape one level down: Value CustGroup, the field NAME as text, where shipped designs use =Labels!@... The op-spec already documents the either/or ("prose titles the RDL header only"), i.e. today a label id gets you labelled metadata plus a broken title, and prose gets you a readable title plus unlabelled objects. Both halves are available from one input; nothing forces the trade.

DEFECT 2 (TOOL_DEFECT, write path). There is NO supported way to correct an AxReport after generation: d365fo_file(action="modify", objectType="report", operation="replace-code") is rejected outright - "Operation 'replace-code' on object type 'report' is not supported by the bridge" - and no report-shaped operation exists in the modify enum. Combined with defect 1 that leaves the grounded path with no way to produce a correct RDL title at all, which is why this golden freezes the literal-@Id title: it is the best the tool can currently emit.

DEFECT 3 (TOOL_DEFECT, generator, functional). The scaffold gives the tmp table a UNIQUE single-field index over the FIRST field and points ClusteredIndex/PrimaryIndex/ReplacementKey at it. For designStyle="GroupedWithTotals" the first field is by construction the GROUP field, i.e. the one value that must repeat across rows - so the generated table can only ever hold one row per group and processReport() would throw a duplicate-key error on the second customer of any group. It builds clean, so nothing catches it. Repaired here through the tool (remove-index + add-index over CustGroup+AccountNum, still unique so the PrimaryIndex/ReplacementKey references stay valid); that repair is what the golden contains.

HARNESS GAP (affects future re-runs, not this score). The RDL carries three per-generation GUIDs inside the CDATA text - rd:DataSourceID, rd:DataSetID, rd:ReportID - and src/eval/oracle/normalize.ts has no GUID masking, while the case ignore globs (**/@Id, **/ModelSaveInfo) cannot reach inside CDATA. Re-running ANY of the five report cases will therefore report a spurious golden mismatch on those three lines. It did not bite here only because this run captured its own golden.

MINOR: (a) the bridge refused replaceCode on the DP with "oldCode not found" (whitespace-sensitive match) and this server's XML writer completed the same edit - the fallback worked, but the bridge matcher is stricter than the writer's; (b) get_object_info(options.fieldFilter) treats a comma-separated list as one literal substring and reports 0 of 193 matching rather than splitting it; (c) reports were read via get_object_info(objectType="report") throughout, which works - the known search(type="report") filter defect was not exercised further. (d) ROLLBACK HYGIENE: every d365fo_file(modify) wrote a sibling .backup-<timestamp> file into the AOT folder even with createBackup unset, the REJECTED report replace-code wrote one too (before refusing the operation), and d365fo_file(delete) does not remove them - four .backup files survived the object deletes and had to be swept by hand, or the sandbox would not have been clean.
suggested_fix_area:
src/tools/smart/generateSmartReport.ts (RDL emission): when `caption` is a label id (starts with @), emit the RDL title textbox as =Labels!<id> instead of the raw id, and do the same for tablix header cells when a field carries a label - the platform label transformation only fires on the =Labels! form, so a bare @Id renders literally. Cheap deterministic unit test, no VM needed: scaffold with caption="@SYS313987" and assert the ReportTitle Value is "=Labels!@SYS313987"; scaffold with prose and assert it is the prose. That also dissolves the either/or the op-spec currently documents ("prose titles the RDL header only").

src/tools/smart/generateSmartReport.ts (index emission): never make the GROUP field a unique single-field index. For designStyle="GroupedWithTotals" the first field repeats by definition; either widen the unique index to (groupField, next distinct field) as this run did through remove-index/add-index, or fall back to a surrogate index. Test: scaffold GroupedWithTotals and assert the index either allows duplicates or carries >= 2 fields.

src/tools/d365foFile (modify): give AxReport at least one supported operation, or let replace-code fall back to this server's XML writer for reports the way it already does for classes when the bridge declines. Today the refusal is a hard stop with no alternative path, which forces a hand edit and so breaks the grounded-only rule for anything inside an AxReport.

src/eval/oracle/normalize.ts: mask GUIDs (the rd:DataSourceID / rd:DataSetID / rd:ReportID triple, or any 8-4-4-4-12 hex run) before diffing, otherwise every report-case re-run is a false negative on golden_match.
